newsitem.title: FINLAND: Rauma's Sunds wins $50 mln Chilean order.
newsitem.headline: Rauma's Sunds wins $50 mln Chilean order.

text.p: Finnish engineering group Rauma Oy said in a statement on Wednesday its Sunds Defibrator unit had won a $50 million thermomechanical pulp plant order from Chilean Industrial Forestales S.A. Inforsa.

"Sunds Defibrator's delivery covers all equipment for the new mill, from the wood yard to be bleached pulp, and necessary buildings," it said, adding that the plant would be located in Nacimiento, about 560 kilometres south of Santiago.
"The plant will have a capacity of 660 tonnes per day with radiate pine as the raw material," Rauma said.
It said scheduled start-up was autumn 1998.
